title: Foundational Training
description: Complete the core foundational modules required for all assembly technicians. Covers safety, frame/chassis, and basic orientation before moving to specialized systems.

knowledgeChecks.question: Before starting any assembly work, what is the most important first step?
options: Jump straight into assembly to save time
Complete orientation, wear proper PPE, and understand your workspace
Ask a coworker to show you what to do
Review only the frame assembly steps
knowledgeChecks.explanation: Proper orientation ensures you know PPE requirements, safety zones, emergency procedures, and workspace layout before touching any components.

knowledgeChecks.question: What is the correct order for frame and chassis assembly?
options: Frame structure first, then mount sub-components
knowledgeChecks.explanation: The main frame structure must always be assembled and verified before mounting any sub-components. This ensures structural integrity throughout the build.
